title: The Wedding
text: So you are to be married in Highmarch, to a man whose tower looks at the sea. A Voice may not leave the Beacon in the sowing. Wear Mother's pearls. Be kind to his steward, Varro. He counts the spoons. Someone must.
note: In a chest in the wreck yard, tied with a knotted string that once held pearls.
where: The Drowned Mole, the moles at low water
